text:
sophie: quick note: saw heavy latency when router did wide compatibility checks because clients were trying to stitch two nearby versions but sent no stitch metadata.

kenji: can you paste the header?

sophie: minimal:
```
model_pin: "modelX:sha10"
rollout_metadata: {}
client_hint: "prefer-stitch"
```

alex: proposal: add compact `stitch` wire-entry in rollout metadata: bounded candidates + mode + expiry. Keep payload tiny.

maria: constraints: max 4 candidates, tenant opt-out, and strict provenance check (no cross-tenant ids).

sam: runtime should support `allow` (can pick newer), `require` (exact), and `probe-only` modes and implement probe backoff to avoid cache thrash.

kenji: draft compact example for wire: `stitch=c:sha10,sha11;m:allow;e:2026-04-01` (parser-friendly and small). We'll accept old `stitch_hint` for 60d with warning.

alex: runtime plan: try in-memory candidate match -> local cache -> async bounded probe (if mode allows) -> heavy compatibility if all miss. Respect probe_policy per-client.

maria: telemetry: add `stitch_probe_rate`, `stitch_hit_rate`, `stitch_auto_route_rate` and tenant mute controls.

deploy-bot: canary rollout: stitch-compact-schema -> staging (id: scs-202604) :rocket:

sophie: action items: kenji RFC, alex router patch, maria client-sdk probe_policy, sam telemetry + tests. I'll open PRs.
